items.title: Add `exclude-newer` to `[[tool.uv.index]]`
items.reason: Introduced index cutoffs with explicit precedence: top-level exclude-newer-package > index exclude-newer > global exclude-newer. The implementation and existing lock_exclude_newer_index_value integration test establish the supported configuration; exclude-newer-package is not an index-table setting.

items.title: `exclude-newer-index`: per-index cooldown periods
items.reason: The same reporter previously requested per-index cooldowns with package exemptions taking precedence. A maintainer pointed to astral-sh/uv#18839, and the reporter confirmed it supplied the requested feature. This establishes intended precedence rather than tracking the current validation or diagnostic defects.

items.title: Make error caused by `--exclude-newer` clearer
items.reason: Historical discussion of confusing 'no version' wording when a cutoff excludes a release. Later comments identify astral-sh/uv#18217 and astral-sh/uv#18952 as adding cutoff hints. The new report demonstrates working global-cutoff hints but a distinct index-only diagnostic gap.

items.title: Improve `--exclude-newer` hints
items.reason: Expanded cutoff hints to explain excluded requested versions even when older versions remain available. Relevant to the missing explanation here, but it does not establish that ordinary index discovery previously received that explanation or that this is a regression.

related.search_scope: Searched astral-sh/uv open and closed issues and open, closed, and merged PRs using authenticated gh. Literal searches covered index-exclude-newer, exclude-newer-package, exclude-newer, 'Because there is no version', 'subsequent index', and 'index-specific'. Conceptual searches covered per-index cooldowns, package exemptions and precedence, ignored configuration, unknown index fields, cutoff diagnostics, and script resolution, with package/version/platform details removed. Also searched 0.13.7 and historical fixes. PR searches returned no matches; relevant PRs were inspected through issue/comment reference chains, including astral-sh/uv#19749 → astral-sh/uv#18839 and astral-sh/uv#18949 → astral-sh/uv#5878 → astral-sh/uv#18217 / astral-sh/uv#18952. Ruled out astral-sh/uv#19239 (transitive dependency constraints), astral-sh/uv#21211 and astral-sh/uv#21227 (standalone ty selection by uv check), astral-sh/uv#19266 (pre-release hint), astral-sh/uv#12340 (available-version bounds), and astral-sh/uv#22951 (promoting existing parse warnings to errors). No existing item was found tracking this index-table validation and ordinary-index cutoff diagnostic combination.

type_reason: The final script places exclude-newer-package inside an index table, while the supported setting belongs under tool.uv. Source and an existing integration test confirm correctly scoped package exemptions override index cutoffs. However, IndexWire silently ignores the misplaced key, and the diagnostic path consults index cutoffs only for explicitly constrained package indexes, omitting the cutoff explanation during ordinary index discovery. These validation and misleading-output defects warrant bug classification. No duplicate or confirmed regression was established.
summary: astral-sh/uv#18839 and astral-sh/uv#19749 establish package-over-index precedence. astral-sh/uv#5878 and astral-sh/uv#18952 provide historical diagnostic context. No duplicate found; the report exposes a silently ignored index-table key and a missing cutoff explanation.
draft_response:
Move `exclude-newer-package.uv = false` into `[tool.uv]`, before `[[tool.uv.index]]`, and leave `exclude-newer = "2026-11-01"` on the index. Package exemptions take precedence over index cutoffs, as implemented in astral-sh/uv#18839 and covered by an existing integration test.

Your example also exposes two problems: the unsupported index-level key is silently ignored, and the error omits the active index cutoff while suggesting an index-strategy change. Those validation and diagnostic issues need addressing. Please retry with the exemption under `[tool.uv]`; if resolution still fails, share the revised script and verbose output.
